page.notes: The page number is printed as 51ȝ (old-style 3); transcribed as 513 with [?]. The running head is printed in large italic capitals. The woodcut-like initial N of "Nullum" is joined to the word. The line "XCV." is a numbered item, so it is kept as a heading. Possible doubtful readings: "asidentem" (printed with an initial long-s-like letter), "exi-sta" (the word is split across lines as "exi-" / "sta", transcribed as printed), and "suaq;" (abbreviation mark uncertain). The final line "su-" continues on the next page.
